$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.4.16 (Method 3, wind tunnel procedure) and Sec 1.5.3.5 (wind tunnel test); the code has no numerical (CFD) procedure

SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 is silent: directions every 30°, z0 by exposure from the ASCE 7 commentary's typical values, the CFD storey forces at least 80 % of the code's (after ASCE 7-22 Sec 31.4.3); see VERIFY.md
source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.4.16 (wind tunnel procedure); SAEngine practice for the CFD values the code does not give
validation: BNBC 2020 accepts wind loads from a wind tunnel test (Method 3) meeting the test conditions of Sec 2.4.16.2: a modelled atmospheric boundary layer and its turbulence scales, geometric similarity of the building and its surroundings, blockage, the pressure gradient, Reynolds number effects and the instrumentation. A CFD simulation is not such a test.

sources.directionStep: SAEngine practice: 12 directions every 30° (BNBC 2020 gives no number of directions)
sources.roughness: SAEngine practice: z0 of exposures A, B, C (BNBC 2020 Sec 2.4.6.3) as the typical z0 of the corresponding ASCE 7 exposures B, C, D (ASCE 7-22 Commentary Table C26.7-1)
sources.lowerLimit: SAEngine practice after ASCE 7-22 Sec 31.4.3 (BNBC 2020 Sec 2.4.16 gives no lower limit)
sources.validation: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.4.16.2 (test conditions) and Sec 1.5.3.5
